findings.reason: Verified that deleteCache's mutation only calls onSuccess and never invalidates connectedCalendars, while the wrapper query has refetchOnWindowFocus false and EventAdvancedTab passes no onChanged, so the stale 'Last updated' stays visible after a successful delete.

Confirmed the Alert branch previously gated only on delegationCredentialId and now also gates on disableConnectionModification, which EventAdvancedTab sets to true, so broken-credential rows lose their remove action; a real behaviour change that merits a comment rather than a blocker.

The claim that Prisma skips @updatedAt on an empty-data updateMany is unverified and uncertain, though the point that nothing in the PR reads SelectedCalendar.updatedAt, so the extra DB write is of doubtful value, holds.
A plain Error becomes INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR rather than NOT_FOUND, which is a valid convention point, but the client-visible behaviour is only a generic toast, so the impact is small.
Hardcoding en-US for the timestamp inside a translated sentence is a verified localisation inconsistency, but it is cosmetic and affects only non-US users' readability.
The BSD-only sed -i '' and the cwd-relative ENV_FILE are real portability and path defects in a developer script, but the impact is limited to local dev use on the wrong platform or directory.
The DEFAULT NOW() backfill does make existing rows show the deploy time as last updated, a valid but minor UX inaccuracy that is an acknowledged trade-off in the migration comment.
